harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: two holds, each request with its positive control. (1) Kind war, STS.ubase <- UMOV: the UNIFORM base register of a shared store (STS [UR6+0x24], R6 with a read barrier that only the checksum word waits; every lane of a warp stores the same value through the address of lane 0's line) rewritten by UMOV d issue cycles behind the store, with no wait on the store's read barrier; the rewritten base points at another valid word of the CTA, so a store that takes it shows as the warp's word not written; seven grids (2 and 4 CTAs per SM among them), with and without 15 STS.128 queued in front; variants: no UMOV, the UMOV waiting the read barrier; the control UMOV.front has the same UMOV 45 cycles in front of the store. (2) Kind mma, hold_c_cs2r / hold_c_prmt / hold_c_mov: the hold of the ACCUMULATOR quad of QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8 and HMMA.16816.F32.BF16 behind the word against the 64-bit CS2R R, SRZ (two registers of the quad), PRMT and MOV, with the word's result on another quad and - dest a - on its own A quad; the controls sens_c_* have the overwriter 45 cycles in front of the word

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: f62e790 tools/stallfloor/probe.py 24, second part: the hold of each register of the accumulator quad; the Workstation co

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

requests.pair: STS.ubase <- UMOV (version 25: `UMOV UR6, 0x10` rewrites the UNIFORM base register of `STS [UR6+0x24], R6` d issue cycles behind the store; the store carries a read barrier in every variant: bare = the overwriter does not wait it, ctl = no overwriter, rb = the overwriter waits it; every lane of a warp stores the same value through UR6 = the address of lane 0's line; a store that takes the rewritten base goes to another valid word of the CTA)

STS.ubase <- UMOV.front (version 25: `UMOV UR6, 0x10` rewrites the UNIFORM base register of `STS [UR6+0x24], R6` 45 cycles IN FRONT of the store, the model ignoring it - the POSITIVE CONTROL: expect 0 % good; every lane of a warp stores the same value through UR6 = the address of lane 0's line; a store that takes the rewritten base goes to another valid word of the CTA)

QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8: the operand hold (one MMA whose result goes to another quad; the 64-bit CS2R Rn, SRZ zeroes TWO registers of its ACCUMULATOR d cycles behind it) [the rewritten register is R30 and R31 of the accumulator quad R28..R31; the word's result goes to R24..R27]

QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8: CONTROL: the 64-bit CS2R zeroes the two accumulator registers IN FRONT of the MMA whose result goes to another quad (expect 0 % good) [the rewritten register is R30 and R31 of the accumulator quad R28..R31; the word's result goes to R24..R27]
